title: OpenAI models help reduce circuit area in the Jalapeño inference chip
summary: OpenAI estimates that AI-proposed changes cut standard-cell area by about 13% in the vector unit and 10% in the matrix unit. OpenAI reports that the optimizations were verified during silicon bring-up. The August announcement reported chip-level performance, while this November account provides the unit-level area estimates.

evidence.tested: OpenAI reports engineering verification and silicon bring-up.
evidence.unknown: The aggregate area savings are company estimates. Independent replication and model-by-model contributions were not reported.
evidence.ai_role: OpenAI engineers used models to propose arithmetic, circuit and pipeline changes. The account identifies o3-mini in early work and does not assign the full savings to one model.
